objective: Preparar mapa exacto de implementacion R24 para integrar Rendimiento por Lote Proveedor y Reclamos en Tablajeria, reutilizando Compras, Inventarios, Proveedor_Catalogo, Centro de Control, Scheduler y auditoria existentes. Debe identificar archivos exactos a modificar, tablas existentes a reutilizar, tablas faltantes a crear mediante migracion, endpoints requeridos, servicios requeridos, componentes frontend requeridos, jobs scheduler requeridos, permisos RBAC requeridos, y pruebas minimas. No modificar codigo, datos, permisos ni Produccion.

queries.name: r24_existing_tablajeria_tables
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, TABLE_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Tablaj%' ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME

queries.name: r24_existing_compras_lote_proveedor_tables
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME, TABLE_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Compra%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Recepcion%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Proveedor%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Factura%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Lote%' ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME

queries.name: r24_tablajeria_order_columns_safe
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME IN ('Operaciones_Tablaje_Ordenes','Operaciones_Tablaje_OrdenesDetalle','Tablajeria_CosteoProduccion','Tablajeria_CosteoDetalle','Tablajeria_MovimientosInventario') ORDER BY TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION

queries.name: r24_compras_trace_columns_safe
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_NAME, COLUMN_NAME, DATA_TYPE FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE (TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Compra%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Recepcion%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Proveedor%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Factura%' OR TABLE_NAME LIKE '%Lote%') AND (COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%ID%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Lote%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Proveedor%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Factura%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Orden%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Recepcion%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Producto%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Insumo%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Cantidad%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Peso%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Costo%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Importe%' OR COLUMN_NAME LIKE '%Fecha%') ORDER BY TABLE_NAME, ORDINAL_POSITION

queries.name: r24_missing_target_tables_probe
queries.sql: SELECT TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME IN ('Tablajeria_LotesProveedorRendimiento','Tablajeria_ReclamosProveedor','Tablajeria_ReportesLote','Tablajeria_ReportesLoteDestinatarios','Tablajeria_NotificacionesLote','Tablajeria_KPIsProveedorLote','Tablajeria_LoteDrilldown') ORDER BY TABLE_SCHEMA, TABLE_NAME

expected_findings: Mapa de archivos exactos para R24B mutation.
Tablas existentes a reutilizar de Tablajeria, Compras, Inventarios y Proveedores.
Tablas faltantes para rendimiento por lote, reportes automaticos, reclamos y notificaciones.
Endpoints backend requeridos sin duplicar rutas existentes.
Servicios backend requeridos para calculo de rendimiento, impacto economico y reclamo.
Componentes frontend requeridos para tablero, drilldown, reclamos y reportes.
Scheduler job requerido reutilizando scheduler existente.
